degree_rationale: The five cosmic ages/times — from First Man's descent to the Panaretos at the end. Treats the essential time-structure of the cosmic drama.
direction_rationale: Illumines the cosmic ages in their proportions — wisdom seeing the whole arc of time at once, comparing greatness of one age to another.
grand_man_function: Celestial temporal panorama — the inmost ages of love's working.
title: The Five Cosmic Ages: how time unfolds from First Man to dissolution
